text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... everyone's expectations
are just hopelessly terrifying to me."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ever since that day, I have spent my days searching for a way to overcome that fear.
choice_data_list: (Is there a good way to handle this…?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While wracking my brain on the way to the Trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki was gazing intently
at a stage play DVD.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah, welcome back, Trainer! Pardon the intrusion.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's a DVD of my mother's stage performance.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...To be honest, I've never once seen
my mother show fear on stage."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even with thousands of spectators before my eyes,
it matters not. I shall race across the stage more freely than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I was just curious how you can face such immense expectations
without feeling afraid."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Is that something only a genius could pull off,
or did she overcome it somewhere along the way...?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure which it is, but I'm certain there's a hint here
to help us take the next step forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed Fuji Kiseki felt the exact same way. In that case—
choice_data_list: Can I watch with you, too?
Mind if I watch with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I brought it along specifically for that, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is set in early modern France.
The story begins with the Queen being
captured and thrown into prison."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: "If only one wish could be granted... Ah, how I yearn to return to beautiful Austria...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Accompanied by her anguished scream,
upbeat music rings out, and the lights suddenly flash on at full brightness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before she knew it, the soot-covered queen had become an adorable young girl, running through the nature-filled castle grounds.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...This stage is a one-woman show by my mother.
All by herself, she portrays the tragic queen's life
and the people around her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cold gaze of the waiter, the back of a downtown girl.
The street performer's lively bark, and the king's quiet monologue.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her roles changed dizzyingly from one to the next,
yet she never lost her composure—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Drawing in the audience with every single word,
sighs and soft gasps leak from the seats
in response.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, before I knew it, I even forgot
that she was a stage actor—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The story was reaching its climax.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki's Mother
text_block_list.text: "I want you, and only you, to burn my image into your memory. With those pitch-black eyes of yours...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A blue bird took flight into the azure sky,
as the cheers of the crowd roared out—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one-woman play concluded
with a long, roaring standing ovation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I intended to search for hints, but before I knew it, I was genuinely enjoying the story.
choice_data_list: They truly are an incredible person.
They truly are an incredible person.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've never seen a stage actor quite like my mother.
It might sound like family bias, but it's the truth.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Many wish to become like that,
but almost none ever do. Myself included.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The consummate entertainer that Fuji Kiseki aims to be.
I felt like I caught a small glimpse of that figure.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Still, on the stage, she really is
just a character, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
There was simply no way
I could have known what was on their mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They don't seem to be on bad terms either, so perhaps it would simply be faster to ask her directly.
choice_data_list: Why don't we just go ask directly?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mm, yeah...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell you the truth, I was avoiding it a bit.
I was scared of what would happen if you didn't understand."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Still... you're right. Watching that performance made me feel like I wasn't in any position to shy away from her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Will you come with me, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, that weekend...
we ended up paying a visit to Fuji Kiseki's mother.
